layout_contract: one canonical file per node with source-owned outgoing typed connections
semantic_projection: layout-neutral graph.json with first-class nodes and edges
provenance_projection: source-manifest.json mapping every graph ID to one project-local source
human_projection: SPEC.md generated only from graph semantics
receipt: build-receipt.json binds source set, language registries, graph, source manifest, and Markdown
selection_assumption: edges have no independently witnessed owner or evidence lifecycle

layout-b.trigger: an edge gains independent owner, evidence, version, or review lifecycle

layout-c.reason: bundle concentration without file-count advantage over layout-a

plan_constraints: keep graph and Markdown generated and drift-checked
preserve FPR-01 and production authority gates
